features.name: Return Policy Retrieval
acceptance_criteria: Return-policy evidence can be retrieved from the knowledge base.
Retrieved policy evidence includes source metadata.
The system does not invent undocumented return policy.

features.name: Eligibility Input Collection
acceptance_criteria: Eligibility evaluation can obtain required order facts from StoreClient.
Eligibility evaluation can obtain applicable policy evidence.
Missing required facts are explicitly detected.

features.name: Return Eligibility Rules
acceptance_criteria: Eligibility rules are based only on documented policy.
Rules are deterministic and inspectable.
No undocumented eligibility rules are introduced.

features.name: Check Return Eligibility Tool
acceptance_criteria: The agent can invoke check_return_eligibility.
The tool combines order facts with policy evidence.
The tool returns a structured eligibility decision.

features.name: Eligibility Explanation
acceptance_criteria: The customer receives a clear explanation of the eligibility decision.
The response cites relevant policy evidence.
The explanation is consistent with the underlying decision.

features.name: Insufficient Evidence Handling
acceptance_criteria: The system does not guess when required evidence is missing.
Insufficient evidence results in a safe response or escalation.
The response explains why eligibility could not be determined when appropriate.

features.name: Conflicting Policy Handling
acceptance_criteria: Materially conflicting policy evidence is detected.
The system does not arbitrarily choose between conflicting policies.
Conflicting policy evidence results in safe escalation.

features.name: Action Boundary Protection
acceptance_criteria: The system does not create a return.
The system does not issue or claim to issue a refund.
The system does not cancel an order.
Eligibility determination remains separate from operational actions.

features.name: Phase 1 and 3 Regression Coverage
acceptance_criteria: Phase 1 knowledge-grounded support remains functional.
Phase 3 order lookup remains functional.
Order information does not leak between customers or orders.

features.name: Phase 4 Behavioural Evaluation
acceptance_criteria: All Phase 4 evaluation cases execute successfully.
Positive, negative and safety-boundary cases are covered.
Evaluation results provide evidence that the feature behaves as specified.
